'The file is written even when the name has no packages left' is the clause a reader would most easily take as decorative, and it is exactly the clause the tree would otherwise violate: write_to rebuilds every NameEntry from by_pkgref, so a name with zero packages would produce no file at all and the name would answer with silence. memory.rs:220 inserts the slot regardless, and the test at :575 is what proves it — it fails if the emit is dropped.
